comments.body: Computational uncertainty between different versions typically arises from variations in operators, communication operators, and the order of accumulation. You may need to use batch invariant feature, or take a look at https://docs.vllm.ai/projects/ascend/en/latest/faqs.html#how-to-generate-deterministic-results-when-using-vllm-ascend
